brief: How does PTT Global Chemical define adjusted EBITDA?

sections.title: PTT Global Chemical: Definition of Adjusted EBITDA
questions: How does PTT Global Chemical define adjusted EBITDA in its filings?
What specific items are excluded from EBITDA to arrive at adjusted EBITDA according to PTT Global Chemical?
sections.tool_rationale: The definition of adjusted EBITDA is a company-specific disclosure found in the text of filings, not in structured data or price series.
sections.unanswerable_if: No PTT Global Chemical filing in the corpus provides a definition or description of adjusted EBITDA.
